text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик defeats Огури Кэп and
Tamamo
Cross to win the Arima Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In the post-race interview, she reflects
on our
hardships and how those trials
have helped us
grow.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She tells the reporters that for her next
goal, she
would like to take part in a
race she has always
dreamed of—the
Osaka Hai.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
